tenderSchedule.description: Request For Proposal (RFP) For Selection Of Transaction Advisor For Development Of Model Sub-Registrar Offices Under Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Model In Karnataka
tenderSchedule.locationName: IGR Department of Stamps and Registration Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Inspector General of Registration and Commissioner of Stamps, Kandaaya Bhavan,8th floor, K G Road,Bengaluru-560009.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Information to Bidders 1.Please note that: The costs of preparing the proposal and of negotiating the contract, including a visit to the DS&R, are not reimbursable as a direct cost of the assignment.2.Government of Karnataka GOK expects the bidders to provide professional,objective,and impartial advice and at all times hold the DS&Rs interests paramount,without any consideration for future work,and strictly avoid conflicts with other assignments or their own corporate interests.Transaction Advisors shall not be hired by the vendor for any assignment that would be in conflict with their prior or current obligations to other clients,or that may place them in a position of not being able to carry out the assignment in the best interest of the DS&R.3.Will reject a proposal for award if it determines that the Bidder recommended for award has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent activities in competing for the contract in question.a)Corrupt practice means the offering, giving,receiving, or soliciting of anything of value to influence the action of a public official in the selection process or in contract execution. and b)Fraudulent practice means a misrepresentation of facts in order to influence a selection process or the execution of a contract to the detriment of GOK, and includes collusive practices among Bidders (prior to or after submission of proposals) designed to establish prices at artificial, non-competitive levels and to deprive GOK of the benefits of free and open competition.

Clarifications on RFP:1.All enquiries or requests for clarification from bidders relating to this RFP shall be submitted in writing through only by e-mail within 7 days of the RFP published, exclusively to the Department of Stamps and Registration (DS&R). Bidders must clearly indicate the relevant section and clause number of the RFP while seeking clarification.2.DS&R shall not be responsible for confirming receipt of any queries submitted by bidders. Further, DS&R does not make any representation or warranty regarding the completeness or accuracy of its responses and is not bound to respond to all queries received. No request for clarification shall be entertained after the last date for submission of queries, as specified in this RFP.

Pre-Bid Meeting:1.The DS&R will host a Pre-Bid Meeting, tentatively scheduled to occur on the date as mentioned in this RFP.2.The purpose of the conference is to provide bidders with information regarding the RFP and the requirements of the Project, and to provide each bidder with an opportunity to seek clarifications regarding any aspect of the RFP and the Project.

Amendment of RFP Documents At any time before the submission of Proposals, the DS&R may, for any reason, whether at its own initiative or in response to a clarification requested by a prospective bidder, modify the RFP documents by amendment. Any amendment shall be issued through publication of addendum in the eProcurement portal. The DS&R may at its discretion extend the deadline for the submission of Proposals.

Liability of the DS&R in preparation & bid submission The DS&R is not liable for any cost incurred by a Bidder in the preparation and production of any Proposal, All materials submitted become the property of the DS&R and may be returned at its sole discretion.

Language of Proposals:The Proposal and all correspondence and documents shall be written in English or Kannada. All Proposals and accompanying documentation will become the property of the DS&R and will not be returned.
Bid Currency: Prices shall be quoted entirely in Indian Rupees.

Correction of error: Bidders are advised to exercise greatest care in entering the pricing figures. No excuse that mistakes have been made or requests for prices to be corrected will be entertained after the quotations are opened.

Disqualification of Bid: The bid is liable to be disqualified in the following cases:1.The Bid not submitted in accordance with this document.2.Bid is received in incomplete form.3.Bid is received after due date and time.4.If there is any inconsistency between the amount quoted in words and the amount quoted in figures, the bid is liable to be disqualified. Bidders are therefore advised to ensure that all financial information is stated clearly and consistently in both words and figures to avoid disqualification.

Format and Signing of Bid: 1.The Bidder must organize the bid in accordance with the format specified in the RFP only.2.All proposals must be signed with the bidders name and by a representative of the bidder, who is authorized to commit the bidder to contractual obligations. All obligations committed by such signatories must be fulfilled.
All Terms and Conditions are As per RFP(Tender Document)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have been in operation for at least 10 years as of 01/01/2026

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Evidenced by Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Commencement of Business issued by Registrar of Companies, India

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have experience in providing Transaction Advisory / PPP Advisory Services to Central Government, State Government, Government Departments, Government Agencies, PSUs or other public sector entities.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work Order / Agreement and Completion / Performance Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have successfully completed at least 3 PPP / Transaction Advisory assignments involving project structuring, financial modelling, transaction documentation, bid process management and/or selection of private partner.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work Order / Agreement and Completion / Performance Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have experience in preparation of PPP financial models, commercial structures, revenue-sharing mechanisms and project risk allocation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work Order / Completion Certificate and Assignment Details

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have experience in preparation / review of RFQ, RFP, Concession Agreement and other transaction documents for PPP projects.
The Bidder should have experience in managing or assisting PPP bid processes, including evaluation of bids, negotiations and selection of private partner / concessionaire.
The Bidder should have an operational office located in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Address Proof / Lease Agreement / Utility Bill

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Type of Organization (Company )
The Bidder must be a company registered under the Indian Companies Act
The Bidder should have SEI-CMMI Level 3 Certification or above
The Bidder shall nominate a Key Transaction Advisor / Team Leader who shall be responsible for overall delivery of the assignment and shall be the principal point of coordination with the Department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Detailed CV of proposed Key Transaction Advisor / Team Leader

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The proposed Key Transaction Advisor / Team Leader should have minimum 12 years of professional experience, with 5 years of experience in PPP / Transaction Advisory / Infrastructure Advisory assignments.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Detailed CV and supporting experience documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The proposed Key Transaction Advisor / Team Leader should have successfully handled / led at least 3 PPP / Transaction Advisory assignments involving Government / PSU / public-sector clients.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- CV, Work Orders / Completion Certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The proposed Key Transaction Advisor / Team Leader should have demonstrated experience in PPP structuring, financial modelling, commercial structuring, revenue-sharing mechanism, risk allocation and transaction documentation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- CV and relevant assignment details

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall propose suitably qualified personnel for Financial / PPP Advisory, Legal / Transaction Advisory and Technical / Infrastructure Advisory requirements of the assignment.

The proposed Key Transaction Advisor / Team Leader shall be actively involved in the assignment and shall be available for meetings, presentations, negotiations and other activities as required by the Department.
The Bidder should not have been blacklisted or debarred by any Central Government, State Government, Government Department, PSU or Government Agency.
Consortium / Sub-contracting shall not be permitted.
The Bidder should be registered under GST.
The Bidder should be registered under GST and applicable laws.
The Bidder should have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 50 Crore during the last three financial years.
